assets.statement: Refuted: for m=κ=(2^ℵ₀)+, colouring by stationary partition of sup A (Solovay) plus the club C_X of countable sups of any unbounded X makes every X∈[κ]^κ see all κ colours, so the canonical statement holds at m=κ and the proposed negative close fails; full-scope affirmative (all infinite m) remains

k=1 case does not transfer: iterating gives F(N+k)≤F(N)+k not +1; no rigidity lemma or branch-B witness supplied; closer refusal upheld; repair needs either structural rigidity of maximal Sidon extensions (KSS obstruction on record from erdos44 R002/L1) or explicit infinite family with F(N+k)≥F(N)+2

L1 = "record bounds 5≤min s≤10^7 close Branch A" fails: minimal case k=5 — no ∀-side obstruction for min s specifically, quantifier slip confirmed, and the route continues only by renaming the difficulty (§4.1 circularity); repair = explicit m with colouring witness s≤m plus universal (m−1)-term blu

L1-as-branch-B-evidence fails: Maynard bound is subsequence-only (hidden-subsequence attack) and does not match the quantifier reversal of o(log N) (needs all-N failure at positive density, not infinitely many N); repair = uniform c·log N lower bound on the full primes, an equivalent-strength open p

minimal witnesses (3,2) and (2,2) both violate n≥2k (n<2k), so the certified-census claim is false on the canonical domain; first admissible k=2 pair is (6,2) with deficiency 0; repair requires domain-exact census plus explicit B(k) and proved finite-core transfer

Counterexample A=ℝ: every affine image is ℝ, not meager, so the meagerness lemma and its fat-Cantor proof route fail; a correct affirmative close needs a different construction uniform in all infinite A.
